class.name: NSUbiquitousKeyValueStore
class.brief_description: Shares small preferences between a user’s Apple devices through iCloud.
class.description:
Uses Apple’s shared default key-value store. Keep this wrapper while you need its signals. Connect [signal did_change_externally] before you call [method synchronize] at launch. Each wrapper registers a native observer and removes it when released. Keep a local copy of preferences so the app works without iCloud. The exported app needs the com.apple.developer.ubiquity-kvstore-identifier entitlement. Use the same store identifier on all app targets that must share values.
Values can be bool, int, float, String, PackedByteArray, Array, or Dictionary. Dictionary keys must be strings. Nested containers can have at most 64 levels. Null entries and other Godot types are rejected. Setters return false for invalid input. A true result only confirms that the binding passed the write to Apple. It does not confirm cloud delivery or quota acceptance.
Apple permits 1,024 keys and 1 MB of values in total. A single value can be at most 1 MB. Each key can have at most 128 UTF-16 code units. Use this store for preferences that change infrequently. Keep sensitive data in Keychain. Windows and Linux stubs do not store or synchronize values.

link.title: Apple: Synchronizing App Preferences with iCloud

method.name: array_for_key
method.description: Returns the Array value for the key. Returns an empty array if the key is absent. Use [method object_for_key] to check whether a key exists.

method.name: bool_for_key
method.description: Returns the bool value for the key. Returns false if the key is absent. Use [method object_for_key] to check whether a key exists.

method.name: data_for_key
method.description: Returns the PackedByteArray value for the key. Returns an empty byte array if the key is absent. Use [method object_for_key] to check whether a key exists.

method.name: default_store
method.description: Returns a new Godot wrapper for Apple’s shared default store. Construction with new() uses the same native store. Keep one wrapper to receive its signal. On Windows and Linux, the stub returns null.

method.name: dictionary_for_key
method.description: Returns the Dictionary value for the key. Returns an empty dictionary if the key is absent. Use [method object_for_key] to check whether a key exists.

method.name: double_for_key
method.description: Returns the float value for the key. Returns 0.0 if the key is absent. Use [method object_for_key] to check whether a key exists.

method.name: long_long_for_key
method.description: Returns the int value for the key. Returns 0 if the key is absent. Use [method object_for_key] to check whether a key exists.

method.name: object_for_key
method.description: Returns the value, or null if the key is absent. Data becomes PackedByteArray. Nested arrays and dictionaries are converted recursively. Native Date values become float Unix seconds.

method.name: remove_object_for_key
method.description: Removes the key and its value. Local removal does not emit [signal did_change_externally].

method.name: set_array
method.description: Sets the value for the key. Returns false for invalid input. A true result confirms that the binding passed the write to Apple. It does not confirm quota acceptance or cloud delivery. Local writes do not emit [signal did_change_externally]. All dictionary keys must be String. Containers can contain only supported property list values.

method.name: set_bool
method.description: Sets the value for the key. Returns false for invalid input. A true result confirms that the binding passed the write to Apple. It does not confirm quota acceptance or cloud delivery. Local writes do not emit [signal did_change_externally].

method.name: set_data
method.description: Sets the value for the key. Returns false for invalid input. A true result confirms that the binding passed the write to Apple. It does not confirm quota acceptance or cloud delivery. Local writes do not emit [signal did_change_externally].

method.name: set_dictionary
method.description: Sets the value for the key. Returns false for invalid input. A true result confirms that the binding passed the write to Apple. It does not confirm quota acceptance or cloud delivery. Local writes do not emit [signal did_change_externally]. All dictionary keys must be String. Containers can contain only supported property list values.

method.name: set_double
method.description: Sets the value for the key. Returns false for invalid input. A true result confirms that the binding passed the write to Apple. It does not confirm quota acceptance or cloud delivery. Local writes do not emit [signal did_change_externally].

method.name: set_long_long
method.description: Sets the value for the key. Returns false for invalid input. A true result confirms that the binding passed the write to Apple. It does not confirm quota acceptance or cloud delivery. Local writes do not emit [signal did_change_externally].

method.name: set_object
method.description: Sets a supported property list value. A top-level null removes the key. Unsupported types, null entries in containers, non-string dictionary keys, and containers deeper than 64 levels cause the entire write to fail. Returns false for invalid input. A true result does not confirm quota acceptance or cloud delivery.

method.name: set_string
method.description: Sets the value for the key. Returns false for invalid input. A true result confirms that the binding passed the write to Apple. It does not confirm quota acceptance or cloud delivery. Local writes do not emit [signal did_change_externally].

method.name: string_for_key
method.description: Returns the String value for the key. Returns an empty string if the key is absent. Use [method object_for_key] to check whether a key exists.

method.name: synchronize
method.description: Returns Apple’s synchronization result. Connect [signal did_change_externally] first. Call this at launch or when the app returns to the foreground. This does not force an immediate upload or confirm delivery to other devices. A false result can indicate missing app entitlements.

members.member: A snapshot of all stored keys and values. Data becomes PackedByteArray. Native Date values become float Unix seconds.

signal.name: did_change_externally
signal.description: Reports Apple’s external change notification on the main thread when this signal has a connection. The reason is a [enum ChangeReason] value. Read the changed keys from the store to get their current values; keys can have been removed. The key list is empty when Apple omits it. Handle account and quota reasons even when the list is empty. Local writes do not emit this signal.

constants.constant: Values changed in iCloud. Read the changed keys and update local preferences.
Values were downloaded during initial synchronization. Read them before you upload defaults.
The store exceeded its quota. Reduce stored data and keep local preferences available.
The user changed the Apple account. Apply the app’s account policy. Do not upload the previous account’s preferences automatically.
